name: Funwari Loli Maid
source:
Suddenly she introduced herself and said, "I'm Rinka, a private maid for you, Master."

You have the choices to be gentle or naughty to her.
Depending on the selection, she can turn into a lolita queen...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE045758.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
突然她自我介绍道：“我是凛香，是主人你的私人女仆。”

你可以选择对她温柔或顽皮。
根据选择，她可以变成洛丽塔女王……

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE045758.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
